theme: UK ETS biogenic CO2 and biomass MRV controls

sources.name: DESNZ UK ETS monitoring and reporting biomass in installations
verified: guidance is specifically for stationary-installation biomass monitoring and reporting
biomass treatment belongs inside UK ETS monitoring-plan controls
biomass accounting is distinct from generic lifecycle-sustainability claims
landing page does not itself provide parcel emissions

sources.name: DESNZ UK ETS technical guidance and tools
verified: MRR guidance includes general installations, data-flow controls, sampling and analysis
waste voluntary MRV guidance was revised 5 May 2026 to include preliminary and biomass-fraction emission factors
Q2 waste data report template updated 26 June 2026
default factors are conditional monitoring/reporting inputs rather than direct parcel measurements

sources.name: Environment Agency stack-emissions monitoring standards
verified: biogenic CO2 can be measured using long-term samplers
flow-proportional sampling is followed by laboratory analysis
typical integrated averaging period is 28 days
CEN 13883 principles can be applied to biogenic-CO2 analysis

sources.name: DESNZ common biomass sustainability framework consultation
verified: emphasises robust monitoring reporting and verification
consultation proposals are not final measured emissions

global_operations: UK ETS, stack measurement and sustainability roles reconciled
Lifecycle/sustainability evidence not substituted for stack or parcel measurement
Child evidence requires serial publisher and remote readback
